systems.platform: launched in September 2023 in collaboration with Pakistan's NADRA
systems.tiers: almost 57 registration centres across federal member states, 18 mobile registration teams to displaced and rural communities, 35 diaspora registration centres; 1.5 million IDs issued; about 2,000 registrations a day; all 14 banks integrated

note: An account of the Somalia-Pakistan peer-learning roundtable of 16 September 2026 on the national identity system; the registration centres and mobile teams are identity enrolment, and nothing is stated on births or deaths.
